# @agents-js/acp

> Low-level ACP client — spawns an agent process, communicates over stdio/NDJSON, and manages the ACP protocol lifecycle.

---
# @agents-js/acp

> Low-level ACP client — spawns an agent process, communicates over stdio/NDJSON, and manages the ACP protocol lifecycle.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/acp
```
